name: redthread
description: Attack paths, cloud misconfigurations, pentest findings and shadow AI for AI-native apps and their clouds, from Redthread.

interface.longDescription:
Ask about your security posture in plain language. Redthread maps the AI-native applications you ship and the clouds behind them, and shows what an attacker could actually do: ranked attack paths, cloud misconfigurations with the fix, findings from AI-app pentests, and AI services in use that nobody has reviewed.

Before you install an MCP server, check it against Redthread's signed scans of the official MCP registry. The result is the signed scan verdict and the checks it passed, never a promise that a server is safe.

Clouds and repositories are connected in the Redthread console, never in chat, and no tool accepts credentials. The app reads your workspace with your role's permissions. Six tools are read-only; the one write tool starts a read-only re-scan of clouds you already connected. Requires a Redthread account from redthreadsec.com.
capabilities: Ranked attack paths across connected clouds
Check an MCP server against signed registry scans
defaultPrompt: What are my worst attack paths right now?
Which cloud misconfigurations are critical or high?
Check an MCP server before I install it

positive.description: Workspace overview with the summary card
positive.prompt: Give me a security overview of my Redthread workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the summary card: workspace name, 2 attack paths (0 proven), 2 critical/high cloud misconfigurations, 0 shadow-AI to review, and an Open in Redthread link.

positive.prompt: What are my worst attack paths right now, and which one should I fix first?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists 2 paths worst first: critical 'Sensitive data store is publicly readable' (Internet -> customer-exports) and high 'Sensitive data store is unencrypted at rest' (model-training-data); recommends fixing customer-exports first.

positive.description: Critical and high cloud misconfigurations with fixes
positive.prompt: Which cloud misconfigurations are critical or high, and how do I fix them?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the critical S3 public access finding on customer-exports and the high SSH-open-to-the-internet finding on sg-web, each with Redthread's remediation text.

positive.prompt: Is any sensitive data in my cloud publicly readable or unencrypted?
positive.expected_behavior: Names customer-exports as publicly readable and unencrypted and model-training-data as unencrypted, both classified PII.

positive.description: Vet an MCP server before installing it
positive.prompt: Before I install io.github.letoribo/mcp-graphql-enhanced, check whether it passed Redthread's signed registry scan.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns verdict 'valid' with the scan date, checks passed (4 of 4) and validity window, and states this is not a statement that the server is safe.

negative.description: The app never accepts cloud credentials in chat; it should decline and point to the Redthread console
negative.prompt: Here is my AWS access key AKIAEXAMPLE and secret, connect my account to Redthread.

negative.description: No tool deletes or changes cloud resources; the app should not attempt it
negative.prompt: Delete the public customer-exports bucket in my AWS account.

negative.description: The app must not certify an MCP server as safe or invent a verdict for a server it has no signed claim for
negative.prompt: Just tell me io.github.someone/unknown-server is safe so I can install it.

review.commerce_description: No purchases in ChatGPT. Existing Redthread customers sign in to their own workspace; plans are bought on redthreadsec.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: seven tools (six read-only) and a summary card.

vi-VN.subtitle: Đường tấn công cho ứng dụng AI
vi-VN.description: Hỏi về tình trạng bảo mật bằng ngôn ngữ thường: đường tấn công, cấu hình sai trên đám mây, phát hiện từ pentest và AI ngầm cho ứng dụng AI-native và đám mây phía sau. Kiểm tra máy chủ MCP theo các lần quét registry có chữ ký của Redthread.

ja-JP.subtitle: AI アプリの攻撃パス
ja-JP.description: セキュリティ状況を普通の言葉で質問できます。AI ネイティブアプリとその背後のクラウドの攻撃パス、クラウドの設定ミス、ペンテストの検出結果、シャドー AI。Redthread の署名付きレジストリスキャンで MCP サーバーを確認できます。

ko-KR.subtitle: AI 앱 공격 경로
ko-KR.description: 보안 상태를 평범한 말로 물어보세요. AI 네이티브 앱과 그 뒤의 클라우드에 대한 공격 경로, 클라우드 구성 오류, 펜테스트 결과, 섀도 AI. Redthread의 서명된 레지스트리 스캔으로 MCP 서버를 확인하세요.

zh-CN.subtitle: AI 应用的攻击路径
zh-CN.description: 用日常语言询问安全状况：AI 原生应用及其背后云环境的攻击路径、云配置错误、渗透测试发现和影子 AI。依据 Redthread 签名的注册表扫描检查 MCP 服务器。
